name: MuscleMemory
description: Recall verified workflow guidance across agent sessions and record, learn, inspect, and evaluate procedures through five MCP tools.
notes: Local stdio connection. Requires uv/uvx on the MCP host. Run `uv tool install --python 3.12 thewariend-musclememory==0.1.7`, `musclememory init`, and `musclememory key --label openhands --permissions read,write` on that host, then enter the returned api_key. A separate REST daemon is not required. MM_HOME and its initialized database must be accessible to the process that launches MCP; a local workstation folder is not automatically available to a remote runner. This connection does not automatically capture OpenHands tool calls. Use recall before a task, explicitly record actual events with observe, and learn only after independent verification. Two later passing checks and operator approval are required before a new workflow becomes eligible for recall. See the linked integration documentation and v1 contract for runtime profiles and event inputs.

envFields.label: MuscleMemory API key
envFields.helperText: Read/write key from the initialized MuscleMemory installation on the MCP host. Copy api_key from `musclememory key --label openhands --permissions read,write`.

envFields.label: MuscleMemory folder on MCP host
envFields.helperText: Optional initialized folder on the host that launches MCP. Must match the installation that issued the API key. Defaults to ~/.musclememory.
